prompt.text:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one independently drawn game animation sprite, hit reaction E frame 04 of 06, 40ms timing.
Input1 is continuity reference for this same character's accepted hit peak frame03, use its native character scale, head proportions, camera, costume and planted-foot root, but redraw the specified different pose. Input2 is same-direction idle anatomy/identity. Input3 is identity portrait. Input4 is the PRIMARY approved hand-painted Q Daoist style reference, ignore all UI.
Draw the same boy FULL BODY facing screen-RIGHT; nose and gaze clearly screen-RIGHT. 
Pose: Deep cushioning rebound immediately AFTER maximum recoil: hips sink further, both knees deeply flex, chest comes forward from peak recoil toward almost vertical, chin lowers, eyes tightly closed and mouth winces. RIGHT elbow keeps brush in protective diagonal guard across chest with tip forward-down. LEFT hand hugs blank scroll beside ribs. Both shoes planted, distinct bent knees and short shins. This low squat must differ clearly from the reference peak, not shift the whole image.
Identity locks: short messy brown hair with high topknot; one yin-yang hair ornament and plain teal cloth ribbon with NO tassel on ribbon; round face, golden-brown eyes, tiny jade diamond on forehead; charcoal short robe with warm-gold cloud trim, ivory lining, jade belt and yin-yang buckle. Anatomical RIGHT hand always grips ONE large black-shaft calligraphy brush, LEFT hand always holds ONE blank ivory hanging scroll with black/gold rods. Brush must have ONE teal tassel physically attached to the handle BUTT, opposite its white/black bristles; scroll has ONE lower-rod yin-yang/teal tassel. Exactly TWO separate pale-cyan ink spirits beside the scroll, never extra ornaments/limbs or spirit copies. Keep established costume pendants, don't add new ones.
Canvas/framing: one square 1254x1254 true RGBA transparent PNG, requested native at least 1024. Same scale as input1, stable virtual ground y=1155, full shoes within canvas. Root fixed, articulate knees/shoulders/elbows/wrists, retain true body compression; no global translation, zoom, scaling, cropping, mirroring, interpolation, multi-panel sheet, shadows or scene.
Clean polished painted edges and clean alpha, no colored red/yellow/green fringe, white matte or checkerboard. No letters/runes on scroll, text, labels, speed-lines, impacts or large spell effects. Return exactly one sprite.
